{"original_answer": "To make a plastic bottle flower vase, start by using a sharp cutter to cut the mouth of the bottle. You need to cut strips that are about 3/4th of the length of the bottle. Make sure your scissor is sharp for a clean cut. If it’s not, heat it the same way as mentioned in step one. Fold the strips like in the diagram and hold the position for a while. Add marbles, beach glass, or decorative stones in the vase to provide a weighted base. Heating the bottle can ensure your folds do not come apart. Maintain the regularity of the creases and press and fold all the strips outward to make a level edge all the way around. Press the bottle upside down on a flat surface to ensure an even edge. Weave the tip of a strip over the next one and under the next two. Fold and crease it so that the tip is at the place shown here by the arrow.", "source_windows": []}
